name: rclone
description: rclone remote-control daemon with the web GUI: browse, copy and sync files between cloud storage providers and your server.

test: wget -q -O /dev/null --header "Authorization: Basic $(printf %s:%s "$RCLONE_RC_USER" "$RCLONE_RC_PASS" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" http://127.0.0.1:5572/ || exit 1

configFields.label: Login password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The username is rcadmin. Access to this login is equivalent to shell access as the rclone process and reveals every stored cloud credential, so keep it private.

connection.title: Sign in to rclone
connection.description: rclone web GUI. Sign in with username rcadmin and the generated password below.

guide.intro: The rclone remote-control daemon with its web GUI. Cloud provider credentials you add are stored in the persisted config volume.

outputs.label: Web GUI
outputs.help: Opens the rclone web GUI. Your browser asks for the username and password.

features.title: Cloud-to-cloud sync
features.description: Copy and sync files between dozens of storage providers from a browser GUI.

features.title: Persistent config
features.description: Remote credentials and cache stay on project-scoped volumes across deployments.
